controlApi.title: Control API
controlApi.subtitle: <tag1>Personal project</tag1> — Personal Finance Control System — (Node.js + React) - (hand-coded)
controlApi.body: Personal finance control project with JWT authentication, categorized transactions, PDF reports, image upload and monthly goals.
bullets: Implemented stateless JWT authentication, protecting all private routes via an authorization middleware.

Built a transaction system with categorization, recurrence and 5 dynamic filters (month, subscriptions, recurring, income, completed), including a dashboard chart comparing highest/lowest transaction per month.
Implemented PDF report generation with Handlebars, filterable by period and category (expenses/income/subscriptions).
Integrated image upload with Firebase Storage.
Created a monthly financial goals system with a graphical progress view (goal vs. achieved amount).

Wrote 21 automated tests (unit and integration) with JUnit, Mockito and Testcontainers.

scraper.title: The Polite Scraper & LLM Triage API
scraper.subtitle: <tag3>FlyRank AI Internship capstone project</tag3> — (Node.js + Express) - (hand-coded + <tag3>AI</tag3>)
scraper.body: Capstone project for the FlyRank AI Internship — Backend AI Engineering Track.
bullets: Built a resilient web scraping pipeline in Node.js (Cheerio) for collecting, normalizing and validating structured data with Zod, ensuring idempotency and politeness (request delays, timeouts and local cache).

Built an AI endpoint (POST /triage) for automatic message classification with an LLM (OpenRouter/Ollama), applying strict Zod schema validation with error handling (status 400, 422, 504 and 503) and zero raw LLM text leakage.

Implemented resilience and production guardrails: explicit 30s timeout, selective retry policy with exponential backoff, schema-failure repair loop, quarantine logs and an environment-variable kill switch.
Structured an accuracy test suite (evals/run.js) with 8 real cases covering ambiguous scenarios (100% precision) and built a per-token cost logging system for financial predictability in production.
